scripts.build: bun build src/lambda.ts --target node --format esm --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax --sourcemap=linked --external '@aws-sdk/*' --outdir dist --entry-naming index.mjs
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.deploy: bun run check && bun run build && pulumi up --cwd infra && bun run setup-telegram
